test_title: SSC CGL Tier 2 English Previous Paper 1 (Held on: 8 Aug 2022)
subject: english
question:
**Given below are four jumbled sentences. Select the option that gives their correct order forming a meaningful and coherent paragraph.**

A. And every time I stood under the shower, she shouted, "Don't waste water."

B. She had poisoned my mind with the lectures on social awareness, equal rights for the poor, India's socio-ecological problems.

C. Every time I was about to take my first bite of a hot buttered Roti she reminded me of the starving millions in our country and in the whole wide world.

D. It was Priyanka's fault - that stupid sister of mine- the social activist.
solution:
The correct answer is **DBCA**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Sentence D** is the first sentence as it contains introduces a context i.e. Priyanka and her sister and the context.
 
• The next sentence should be **Sentence B** because it mentions the reason for calling Priyanka stupid.
 
• **Sentence C** comes next in order because it specifies how she had poisoned the speaker's mind when he/she was about to take a first bite of a hot buttered roti.
 
• The last sentence should be **sentence A** which starts with **and. **It signifies the **connecting link** between sentence C and sentence A. 
 
• Hence, the correct order of jumbled sentences is mentioned in **DBCA.**

 

**Correct Sequence:** *It was Priyanka's fault - that stupid sister of mine- the social activist. She had poisoned my mind with the lectures on social awareness, equal rights for the poor, India's socio-ecological problems. Every time I was about to take my first bite of a hot buttered Roti she reminded me of the starving millions in our country and in the whole wide world. And every time I stood under the shower, she shouted, "Don't waste water."*
